steps.template_en: Probability space (Ω,F,P): Ω=sample space, F=σ-algebra (events), P=probability measure. Random variable X:Ω→ℝ is a FUNCTION assigning a number to each outcome. P(X≤x)=P({ω:X(ω)≤x}).
steps.template_zh: 概率空间(Ω,F,P)：Ω=样本空间，F=σ-代数，P=概率测度。随机变量X:Ω→ℝ是给每个结果赋数的函数。

steps.template_en: Roll two dice: Ω={(i,j):1≤i,j≤6}, |Ω|=36. X=sum of dice. P(X=7)=|{(1,6),(2,5),(3,4),(4,3),(5,2),(6,1)}|/36=1/6. X is a FUNCTION, not 'random.' Randomness is in Ω.
steps.template_zh: 掷两个骰子：X=和。P(X=7)=1/6。X是函数不是随机，随机性在底层Ω。

steps.template_en: PMF: p_X(x)=P(X=x). CDF: F_X(x)=P(X≤x). For continuous: PDF f_X(x) where P(a≤X≤b)=∫_a^b f_X(x)dx. CDF works for BOTH.
steps.template_zh: PMF: p_X(x)=P(X=x)。CDF: F_X(x)=P(X≤x)。连续：PDF f_X(x)，P(a≤X≤b)=∫_a^b f_X(x)dx。CDF两者都适用。

steps.template_en: Properties: P(A^c)=1-P(A). P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A∩B). If A⊆B, P(A)≤P(B). P(∪Aᵢ)≤ΣP(Aᵢ) (Boole). Law of total probability: P(B)=ΣP(B|Aᵢ)P(Aᵢ).
From 52 cards, draw 5 no replacement: (1) P(all hearts)? (2) P(at least one ace)? (3) X=number of aces. Find PMF. (4) P(X≥2)? (5) With replacement, how does PMF change?
steps.template_zh: 52张牌无放回抽5：(1)P(全红心)？(2)P(至少一A)？(3)X=A数，求PMF。(4)P(X≥2)？(5)有放回PMF变化？

steps.template_en: Probability = SETS and FUNCTIONS. Kolmogorov's axioms gave rigorous foundation. Measure-theoretic foundation makes modern probability (martingales, Brownian motion) possible.
steps.template_zh: 概率=集合和函数。Kolmogorov公理赋予严格基础。测度论使现代概率论(鞅、布朗运动)成为可能。
